newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka in spotlight on sluggish Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka in spotlight on sluggish Latvian bourse.

text.p: Latvian blue chips were mixed on Thursday with Unibanka in the spotlight as it extended recent gains and accounted for the lion's share of turnover.
The bourse index inched up 0.55 percent to 388.15 while the Rietumu index added 0.24 percent to 151.06. Market turnover was 81,000 lats against 108,000 lats.
Three of the six official list stocks rose, two held steady and one, Daugavpils Chain, eased. It dipped to 1.07 lats from 1.09 lats in trade of 3,100 lats.
Unibanka led the way as it added three santimes to 3.40 lats in trade of 60,000 lats.
Dealers said Unibanka's solid interim results and expectations that its performance will remain good should lead to further gains.
"It should be able to reach 3.50 lats in the near future," said one trader.
Traders hope that bargain prices and good results will stimulate activity on the market, which has been hard hit by summer sluggishness.

Most of the foreign portfolio investment which has been channeled into the Baltic region has gone into equities in neighbouring Estonia, which is widely regarded as the most liquid, transparant and profitable market in the region.
